home.title: Find your Soul Core team
home.subtitle: Groups organized to hunt Tibia bosses and trade soul cores. Filter by world, creature, your vocation and open slots — join a team or create your own.
home.empty: No teams found with these filters. How about creating one?
home.vocationHint: Showing teams where a {{vocation}} fits right now — including teams with no composition set.

characters.title: My characters
characters.verifyHelp: Enter the exact character name on Tibia.com. We generate a code you paste into the character's Comment field; we verify it automatically every ~15 minutes.
characters.autoVerifyHint: Verification is automatic and may take up to ~15 minutes after you paste the code into the character's Comment.
characters.empty: You haven't verified any character yet.

myTeams.title: My teams
myTeams.emptyActive: No active teams. Create one or find one on the home page.
myTeams.emptyRequests: You have no join requests. Find a team in the search and ask to join.

createTeam.title: Create team
createTeam.needCharacter: You need a verified character to create a team. Go to My characters.
createTeam.atLimit: You've reached the limit of {{limit}} active teams on the free plan. Complete, let one expire or renew a team, or go premium to create more.
createTeam.worldInfo: The team will be on world {{world}}.
createTeam.huntScheduleHint: Shown in search — it is what makes someone decide the team fits them.
createTeam.descriptionPlaceholder: Strategy, requirements, how loot is split…
createTeam.contactHint: Visible only to you and approved members — never in public search.
createTeam.compositionHint: Says who the team is missing ("1 Knight, 1 Druid"). Leave everything as "any" to accept any vocation — and remember you have to fit the composition too.

teamDetail.noCharacterInWorld: You have no verified character on world {{world}}.
teamDetail.youParticipate: You are part of this team.
teamDetail.renewInfo: This team is archived. Renew it to reopen the hunt (uses one slot of your plan).
teamDetail.kickConfirm: Kick this member from the team?
teamDetail.deleteConfirm: Close this team? It disappears from search and becomes read-only (history is preserved).
teamDetail.closedInfo: This team was closed by the owner.
teamDetail.contactVisibility: Only approved members can see this contact.
teamDetail.editInfo: Need to fix the schedule, description or contact?
teamDetail.editLevelHint: Changing the minimum level applies to whoever joins from now on — nobody already approved is removed.
teamDetail.editClearHint: Any field left blank is removed from the listing.

types.TEAM_MINIMUM_LEVEL_CHANGED: The minimum level of {{team}} has changed
types.JOIN_REQUEST_AT_RISK: Your request to {{team}} may not be approved: the team raised its minimum level
types.JOIN_REQUEST_COMPOSITION_MISMATCH: Your request to {{team}} may not be approved: the composition changed and has no slot for your vocation
types.JOIN_REQUEST_FITS_AGAIN: Your request to {{team}} fits again: the owner changed the requirements

errors.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.crashTitle: Something went wrong on this screen
errors.crashHelp: It wasn't you: part of the page failed to render. Reloading fixes it most of the time.
errors.sectionFailedHelp: The rest of the page still works. Reloading usually fixes this part.

myRequests.issueBelowMinimumLevel: the team now requires level {{minimum}} and your character is {{level}}.
myRequests.issueWorldMismatch: your character is no longer in {{world}}.
myRequests.issueVocationNotInComposition: the team's composition no longer has a slot for {{vocation}} — use another character or look for another team.
myRequests.issueVocationNotInCompositionUnknown: the team's composition no longer has a slot for your character's vocation.

slots.title: Team composition
slots.editHint: The new composition has to fit whoever is already on the team: reordering slots is allowed, and the server refuses naming whoever would be left out. Setting everything to "any" removes the composition.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.explanation: This address doesn't exist on the site:
